text: Let's summarise. Coding-decoding means finding a coding rule from given pairs of original and code words, then applying it consistently. Know your letter positions. Use the E-J-O-T-Y anchors: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25. Opposite letters have positions that add up to 27. The alphabet is circular: after Z comes A. The method is: compare lengths, compare letter by letter, check for reversal or opposite letters, verify on every letter, then apply and eliminate.
